issues.on_page: Capital outlay 40,391 (General Fund column; p12: Park 3,891 + Community Center 36,500)
issues.issue: The funds statement row prints no function. The function comes from the department columns of the p12 combining schedule (both are Environment and leisure departments on p9). The amounts tie exactly, so the assumption is defensible, but the function is not printed on the row itself.

issues.on_page: Utilities 14,097 (proprietary operating expenses, by cost type)
issues.issue: A cost-type line is given the function name 'utilities' as its category, when the cost type is utility bills (detail list: utilities (power, gas, phone)). FY2024 does the same, but the two meanings can't be told apart in the workbook.
The printed line combines salaries and benefits; it is recorded as salaries and wages only. Same for detail[13] (5,917).

The Street Fund schedule prints only 'Intergovernmental'. Highway allocation is inferred (consistent with the p3 'State allocation' 78,725 = 69,481 + General 9,244) and is reasonable, but it is not printed.
